purpose: Line-by-line reconciliation of every curated row against its own official product page, re-read in one automated run (20:21:46Z–20:22:25Z) plus an independent second channel.

method.runner: GitHub Actions run re-opened all 71 curated URLs with a browser user agent and recorded HTTP status, page title, per-product JSON-LD offers, every Shopify seller’s own variant feed, gram text and solid/plated/final-sale wording. It cannot edit the dataset.
method.comparison: A stored single price, or the full stored range, must appear in the page’s own offer data or in the seller’s variant feed for that exact product. Prices are never attributed from cross-sell tiles, and a range is never rounded.
method.independent_channel: A separate page-fetch channel in the sandbox re-read nine sources (gold spot, two Ross-Simons PDPs, one Automic Gold variant feed, one Aurate variant feed, both Menē bands, one Mejuri PDP, one Auvere PDP) so that the runner’s numbers have an independent witness.

findings.title: Menē 24K band prices moved again between 19:38Z and 20:33Z on 2026-10-23
findings.finding: Menē prices track spot gold and repricing was observed twice in one day. The stored rows carry the morning read; the evening read is lower in both cases.
findings.buyer_action: Treat any Menē figure as a quote good for the minute it was read. The published price basis is "starting price — varies with spot gold & ring size", so re-check at checkout.

findings.title: Ten rows returned HTTP 403 to the runner again on 2026-10-23 20:21Z
findings.finding: Five With Clarity rows (their storefront .json also refused), four Cartier rows and one Brilliant Earth row could not be opened by the automated runner. Nothing was confirmed for them today and nothing is presented as fresh.
findings.buyer_action: Open those official pages yourself before buying; the stored values keep their original capture dates.

findings.title: Auvere 22K product prices are not machine-readable on the product page
findings.finding: The four Auvere PDPs printed their specification panel but no price in the text returned by either channel on 2026-10-23; their prices are rendered client-side. The stored prices keep their earlier capture date.
findings.buyer_action: Read the price in the seller cart; do not rely on the stored figure as current.

findings.title: Six published gram weights were not machine-visible in this run
findings.finding: Aurate renders ring weights inside a client-side specification panel and one Ross-Simons weight sits in a script-rendered block; the automated text extraction did not see them today. The stored weights keep the earlier HTML read and are not upgraded to "verified today".
findings.buyer_action: Ask the seller to confirm the gram weight in writing before paying.

findings.title: Anna Sheffield PDPs print no product price; the seller feed still does
findings.finding: The three Anna Sheffield pages show a custom client archive with no product price, while the seller’s own variant feed (annasheffield.com/products/<handle>.json) returns the exact stored ranges ($11,500; $7,150–$9,200; $5,400–$25,100). The rows remain flagged (F37, F44) because the buyer-facing page has no buy box.
findings.buyer_action: Contact the studio to confirm price and availability; the page cannot be purchased from.

findings.title: Withdrawn row rs-939479 still resolves to a different ring
findings.finding: The URL now serves "Italian 14kt Yellow Gold Claddagh Ring" at $499, not the 1.00 ct lab-grown eternity band the row described. Re-confirms F51; the row stays withdrawn and is excluded from the confirmed count.
findings.buyer_action: Do not buy this SKU expecting the eternity band.
